growth.source: Nykaa quarterly earnings materials via Insight Korea
growth.notes: [CORRIDOR] K-beauty transaction value (GMV) on Nykaa grew MORE THAN 60% YoY in Jul-Sep 2025 per Nykaa quarterly earnings materials.
